name: Nishino Aki
source: [url=/c4558]Kou[/url]'s second cousin who he considers as his elder sister. She is known as a "wizard" - a genius programmer in the virtual world. Kou's Simulacrum is her gift from back when she was moving into their dormitory. After the events of Grey Christmas, she takes up employment in [url=/c22842]Tachibana Seira[/url]'s corporation.
